_comment: Deterministic config for the plugin safety harness. test_mode parses the bundled June-2-2026 primary fixtures offline (no network), so both the ticker and called-card screens render identically on any host for golden-image comparison. freeze_time puts the clock on election night: the fixture calls are dated to election day, and hide_called_after_seconds (24h) would otherwise drop every one, leaving election_called to fall back to the ticker.
